kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "this" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

output "json" {
  value = data.aws_iam_policy_document.this.json
}
-- head/main.tf --
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "this" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

output "json" {
  value = data.aws_iam_policy_document.this.json
}
